name: NVIDIA Quadro T1000
memory_bandwidth_basis: GDDR6 10 Gbps x 128-bit = 160 GB/s (NVIDIA Quadro T1000 spec). The scoreboard prints GDDR5; the shipping part is GDDR6.
notes: Small Turing workstation card, 4 GB. The scoreboard memory cell says GDDR5, which the spec sheet does not support. VERIFIED 2026-10-23 against https://www.nvidia.com/content/dam/en-zz/Solutions/design-visualization/productspage/quadro/quadro-desktop/quadro-pascal-p2000-data-sheet-us-nvidia-704443-r2-web.pdf: NVIDIA spec: 4 GB GDDR6, 128-bit, 10 Gbps => 160 GB/s.
